subject: 明代北方府城：北方密檐砖塔（原创扩展）；具体构件断代（待考）。
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Produce one photorealistic ancient Chinese map-building cutout in true transparent RGBA. Image1 is exact mandatory ground geometry; image2 is architecture/material/style reference only. Render the geometry from IMAGE1 exactly, do not rotate, reshape or deepen it. The front two outer ground edges MUST rise/run 1/2, absolute slope 0.500, parallel paving seams on same axes. Orthographic dimetric 2:1, yaw45, vertical edges stay vertical. The geometry template is just the support; render natural stone paving and architecture, remove drawn outlines. Fully opaque fine-grained gray masonry and clay tile texture matching image2; upper-left daylight, extremely short lower-right contact shadow. Full structure and support uncropped. No people, animals, labels, letters, watermarks, scenery or border. Vertical1024x1536. Add same six-storey tall octagonal gray-tan masonry Buddhist brick pagoda from image2 with fine repeated corbel brick courses, plain shallow brick-eaves ledges, recessed arched niches and stacked bronze finial. NO tiled pavilion roofs, NO curved roofs. Exact SQUARE7x7 metre support: left(176,1250),front(512,1418),right(848,1250),back(512,1082); both visible front slopes exactly±0.5. Tower centered at(512,1250); apex near y60. Preserve shape and architectural detailing of image2 but adapt the base to exact guide and lower camera to obey shallow ground slopes. This is a brick Buddhist tower, not a palace or wooden pavilion.
